eyebrow.zh: 室内设计 · 一站式装修 · 雪兰莪 & 吉隆坡

heading.en: Crafting luxury, down to every detail.
heading.zh: 精致装修，让每一寸都物超所值。

lede.en: One-stop design and renovation for terrace, semi-D and bungalow homes. Design, build and furniture, all by our own team.
lede.zh: 专为排屋、独立式、半独立式住宅设计。从设计、装修到家具，全由自家团队包办。

imageAlt.en: A kitchen after renovation by Miss Renovate

intro.en: Luxury isn't about spending more. It's about value you can see in every detail.
intro.zh: 奢华不是越贵越好，而是价值体现在每一处细节。

text.en: Design, renovation and furniture, all handled by our own team, so quality and completion stay on track.
text.zh: 从设计、装修到家具，全由自家团队包办，确保品质与工期完美竣工！

text.en: From design to construction, every detail is done to the highest standard.
text.zh: 从设计到施工，确保每一处细节都做到最好，只为让你的家更完美！

text.en: Carefully selected materials and a professional build team, brought together with top-tier design.
text.zh: 材质严格甄选，加上专业团队施工，融合顶级设计，呈现出有格调的品味！

text.en: See and feel the materials, styles and designs in person before you renovate. What you see is what you get.
text.zh: 让顾客亲自感受材质、风格、设计，所见即所得，装修前确保100%满意！

text.en: Our own renovation team and our own furniture factory. No middlemen, factory prices.
text.zh: 自家装修团队，自家家私工厂，去除中间商，直供工厂价！

heading.en: One team, from design to handover
heading.zh: 从设计到装修，全部帮你包到完

text.en: 3D design drawings tailored to your needs, plus 3D renders. The finished home matches the render by up to 95%.
text.zh: 提供 3D 设计图，根据您的喜好需求设计独一无二的家；3D 效果图，实际还原度高达95%！

text.en: Our own build team for terrace, semi-D and bungalow homes. Modern, Nordic or industrial: the style is yours.
text.zh: 自家装修团队，专为排屋、独立式、半独立式住宅。现代、北欧、工业风，风格随你的喜好。

text.en: Made-to-measure furniture from our own factory. Cabinets, sockets, lights and fans all handled by our team.
text.zh: 自家工厂打造的私人订制家私。橱柜、插座、灯、风扇等，全由我们团队负责。

text.en: Weekly 360° photo and video updates, so you can follow the work without being on site.
text.zh: 每周 360° 照片＋影片更新进度，不用亲自监督，随时掌握进度。

points.en: Light and ventilation first, for brighter, more spacious rooms.
points.zh: 特别注重采光与通风，让空间更明亮宽敞。

points.en: Considered colour: paint and furniture that blend into a calm, relaxing home.
points.zh: 色彩搭配讲究，油漆与家具融合自然，营造温馨放松的氛围。

points.en: Multi-functional storage that makes clever use of every space.
points.zh: 多功能收纳设计，巧妙利用空间，既美观又实用！

intro.en: Real photos from our own jobs.
intro.zh: 来自我们工地的真实照片。

heading.en: Your dream home doesn't have to wait
heading.zh: 您的梦想之家，不必再等了

text.en: Your style, needs, preferences and lifestyle. Consultation is free.
text.zh: 直接告诉我们你想要的装修风格、需求、喜好和生活方式。#免费咨询

text.en: 3D drawings and renders, so you see the result before work starts.
text.zh: 3D 设计图与效果图，装修前先看到成果。

text.en: Our own team builds, with 360° photo and video reports every week.
text.zh: 自家团队施工，每周 360° 照片＋影片汇报进度。

text.en: Custom furniture from our factory, installed and ready to live in.
text.zh: 自家工厂订制家私，安装完成，即可入住。
